test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Study the following information and answer the given question:

E%F means E is the husband of F

E#F means E is the father of F

E$F means E is the sister of F

Then which of the following relations is true to imply that K is the Paternal Aunt of V?
solution:
**Family Chart:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e92618bbd865bfa02f89c5aa6cff5ae8bc38866b13a3110c2f602c70e54458.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 
 
E is

 
 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
%

 
 
 
#

 
 
 
$

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
husband

 
 
 
father

 
 
 
sister

 
 
 

 
 
to F

 
 
 

 

1.T%K$B#C#V

It means: T is the husband of K, K is the sister of B, B is the father of C, C is the father of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d25b8c262daabede3c04283cec055f9046bf1730986ba80dc04e3d2c9a742bfd.png] 

K is not the Paternal Aunt of V.

2. T%B$K#C%V 

It means: T is the husband of B, B is the sister of K, K is the father of C, C is the husband of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ddde9ce0fd3f3db6b457ed44c0a5291097fa290d36bb897469b9330185ca8327.png] 

K is not the Paternal Aunt of V.

3. T%K$C#V$B

It means: T is the husband of K, K is the sister of C, C is the father of V, V is the sister of B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f06566cbacb4414eac52a4dc3a73ebdce746477f86499ad7783f0c4b9a887f27.png] 

K is the Paternal Aunt of V.

4. T#K$B%C$V

It means: T is the father of K, K is the sister of B, B is the husband of C, C is the sister of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a044b968eb2e3a935b9a7950bef6793adc1359cce31933807c1a254d7f5c1a3.png] 

K is not the Paternal Aunt of V.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
